# Ahmed Khedr — AI Engineer & Full-Stack Architect

> AI Engineer specializing in Generative AI, Agentic Systems, and Full-Stack development.
> Based in Cairo, Egypt. Available for AI & software engineering projects.

## About

Ahmed Khedr is a Senior AI Engineer and Full-Stack Software Architect with 14+ years of engineering experience, based in Cairo, Egypt. He began his career in telecommunications infrastructure engineering at leading Egyptian providers (Telecom Egypt / WE and Orange Egypt / Mobinil), then transitioned into software engineering with a focus on AI systems and mobile/backend development.

He specializes in building:
- **Autonomous AI Agent networks** using LangChain and Python
- **RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)** knowledge pipelines with vector databases (Pinecone, ChromaDB)
- **Generative AI** applications with LLM orchestration and prompt engineering
- **Flutter mobile applications** using Clean BLoC Architecture (Android & iOS)
- **.NET Core microservices** deployed on Azure with Docker and CI/CD pipelines

He is currently employed as a Telecommunications Engineer at WE (Telecom Egypt) while actively developing AI and software engineering projects.

## Professional Experience

**Telecommunications Engineer — WE (Telecom Egypt)**
*2022 – Present, Cairo, Egypt*
Overseeing telecommunication infrastructure operations, leading technical engineering teams, and optimizing BSS/OSS enterprise workflows across large-scale telecom environments in Egypt.

**Flutter Developer (Part-Time) — Stormra Ltd**
*2020 – 2022*
Architected and delivered the "Habibi App" — a full-featured social platform featuring real-time socket chat, Google Maps location tracking, media streaming, and push notifications. Built with Flutter & BLoC Clean Architecture.

**Network Planning Engineer — Orange Egypt (Mobinil)**
*2015 – 2022, Cairo, Egypt*
Radio network implementation, KPI telemetry analysis, capacity planning, and coverage quality optimization across GSM & 3G cellular infrastructure.

## Notable Projects

**AI Agent Assistant & RAG Framework**
Autonomous Agentic AI system featuring multi-tool orchestration, vector database RAG knowledge retrieval, and custom execution pipelines using LangChain & Python. Demonstrates multi-agent coordination, tool use, and knowledge retrieval.

**Generative AI Content Automation**
Automated prompt engineering and content generation pipeline leveraging LLMs with automated filtering, template rendering, and quality checks. Built with Python, OpenAI API, FastAPI.

**Habibi Social App**
Production-grade mobile social platform with real-time messaging, Google Maps location integration, push notifications, and media sharing. Built using Flutter & BLoC Clean Architecture with Firebase backend.

**.NET Microservices Cloud Platform**
High-throughput enterprise backend using .NET Core microservices, containerized with Docker, deployed on Azure with automated CI/CD pipelines.
